messages.subject: Project Redwood – EXCHANGED
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Good news – we exchanged contracts on Kingsgate House this afternoon under Law Society Formula B. The deposit of £1,850,000 has been sent to Marlowe Greaves as stakeholder. Completion is set for 15 May 2026.

Next steps: pre-completion OS1 and bankruptcy searches, the completion statement and apportionments, and we'll request the balance of completion monies from Rebecca nearer the time. Congratulations to the team.

James Osei
Senior Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
